# Jilu

> Free TV Time alternative — track series, films, anime, manga, books, and video games in one place.

## What is Jilu?

Jilu is a free personal media tracker built as a replacement for TV Time. It lets you track series, films, anime, manga, books, and video games — all from a single app, episode by episode.

## Key features

- Episode-by-episode tracking with per-episode ratings and comments
- Release calendar showing upcoming episodes and new releases
- Detailed stats: hours watched, top genres, weekly activity, average rating
- Multi-source search: TMDB, AniList, RAWG, Google Books, Spotify
- Public profiles shareable at /u/yourhandle
- TV Time data import (ZIP export → instant migration)
- Bilingual: English and French
- PWA: works on desktop, iOS, and Android without an app store

## Pricing

Free. No subscription, no premium tier, no ads, no hidden fees.

## App

- [Jilu](https://jilu-app.vercel.app/): Web app (PWA)
- [Privacy Policy](https://jilu-app.vercel.app/privacy)

## FAQ

Q: Is Jilu free?
A: Yes, completely free. No subscription, no premium tier, no hidden fees.

Q: What can I track on Jilu?
A: Series, films, anime, manga, books, and video games — all in one place, episode by episode.

Q: Is Jilu a TV Time alternative?
A: Yes. Jilu was built by a TV Time user as a free replacement covering all the same features plus detailed stats, a release calendar, and public profiles.

Q: Does Jilu work on mobile?
A: Yes. Jilu is a PWA — install it on iOS or Android directly from your browser, no app store needed.

Q: Can I import my TV Time data?
A: Yes. Export your TV Time data, upload the ZIP to Jilu, and your entire watch history imports in seconds.
